verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-to-right order: brand and headline on the left, then date and a prominent RSVP button in the middle. Its flaws: the pills are spread unevenly along the bottom, the legal text is tiny and crammed right next to the Tastings pill, and the missing-asset placeholder is clipped at the right edge. B buries the CTA: RSVP shrinks into a pill the same size as the tag pills. B also has a jumbled pill row that crowds the headline, a subhead squeezed into a narrow column that wraps over five lines, a gap between the date and time, a 'SOLST CE' wordmark that looks broken, and a decorative dot that collides with the 'Reserve a spot' text.
